definitions.policy: triage.nsf: a support backlog owned by a pool (ADR-0025). Anyone files a ticket; the triage team holds the backlog collectively (responsible = group:triage) and a member picks one up by claiming it into in-progress, where the engine stamps that member as the individual assignee. The pool survives pickup: teammates keep seeing claimed work via responsible in @me, while the claimant sees it in assignee in @me. Neither field is enforcement — who may claim/resolve stays in requiredRole.

definitions.title: Triage Board
definitions.description: A pooled support backlog: employees file tickets, the triage team owns the queue collectively, and a member claims a ticket to become its individual owner. Demonstrates ADR-0025 standing responsibility (the pool) versus individual assignment (the claimant).

definitions.title: Ticket
definitions.description: A support ticket filed against the triage backlog: what is wrong, how urgent, and — once picked up — which team member owns it.

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Detail
fields.helpText: Steps to reproduce, context, and anything the triage team needs to act.

definitions.title: Ticket Triage
definitions.description: A ticket's life on the backlog: filed into the pool, claimed by a triage member (who becomes its individual owner), and resolved — or returned to the pool, which clears the individual and puts it back up for grabs.

states.name: new
states.label: New
states.description: Just filed; not yet on the triage backlog. No routing until it is filed into the pool.

states.name: backlog
states.label: Backlog
states.description: On the shared triage backlog: the pool is accountable (responsible = group:triage) and no individual owns it yet. Up for grabs.

states.name: in-progress
states.label: In progress
states.description: Claimed by a triage member. The pool stays accountable (responsibleFormula re-declares it, so teammates still see it) while the claimant is stamped as the individual owner (assigneeFormula: user). requireAssignee makes the claim fail-closed: entry is rejected if no individual resolves, so a claimed ticket never lands owner-less.

states.name: resolved
states.label: Resolved
states.description: Work is done. Terminal — the engine clears both the pool and the individual (nothing is owed on a done ticket).

states.name: cancelled
states.label: Cancelled
states.description: Withdrawn without resolution (from any non-final state). Terminal; clears all routing.

transitions.label: File to backlog
transitions.description: Move a new ticket onto the shared triage backlog. Stamps the pool as responsible; leaves it unowned.

transitions.label: Claim
transitions.description: A triage member picks up a backlog ticket, becoming its individual owner. Pickup is an ordinary transition (ADR-0025 §4) gated by pool membership via requiredRole — no bespoke claim operation.

transitions.label: Return to backlog
transitions.description: Put a claimed ticket back on the shared backlog. Clear-then-stamp clears the individual owner (backlog declares no assigneeFormula) while re-stamping the pool, so it is up for grabs again and off the returner's My Work.

transitions.label: Resolve
transitions.description: Close a claimed ticket. Final state clears both the pool and the individual.

transitions.label: Cancel
transitions.description: Withdraw a ticket from any non-final state.
